title: EOS Quantity
description: Immutable value object representing one finite numeric value with an authoritative future Unit Catalog reference.

value.description: Single scalar numeric value. The schema intentionally defines no engineering minimum, maximum, tolerance, uncertainty, precision, or resolution.

unitId.description: Identifier of a future Unit Catalog Entry. The referenced catalog is not implemented by this contract.

notes.description: Optional local note. It must not define unit meaning, conditions, tolerance, uncertainty, source evidence, conversion, or display formatting.
